messages:
sara: Quick sync — LangChain & LlamaIndex integration roadmap. want to align on tech blockers + announcement window.
kevin: Tech note: LangChain connector PR is nearly ready but needs gateway auth flow for token passthrough.
maria: Is that the same gateway changes we discussed for the SAM deployment?
kevin: yep. need an endpoint that forwards client creds and preserves model pinning metadata.
jon: From partnerships side, LangChain team asked about a joint marketplace listing. they want a one-page reference arch + usage playbook.
clara: For marketplace we need: listing copy, logos, one-liner, supported models, and billing/contact details.
sara: Can eng produce a small reference app that shows: LangChain -> Redwood Gateway -> model pinned to 'redwood-optimized/xx'? Short demo video too.
kevin: I can carve out a sprint task. estimated 3 days to wire up sample with streaming and function-calling.
maria: Also LlamaIndex asked about schema mapping and vector store compatibility (we need to confirm embedding dims and default distance metric).
jon: Good call. i'll ask LlamaIndex to confirm supported dims and whether they want a prebuilt connector.
sara: Timeline idea: dev finish by 3/31, internal QA 4/3-4/7, joint announcement week of 4/14. Thoughts?
clara: That aligns with cloud marketplace Q2 feature push. we should submit marketplace draft by 4/1 to hit the 4/14 window.
kevin: Blocking: hardware partner (NVIDIA) wants to sign off on quantized model perf claims before we publish benchmarks on the listing. that might add a week.
maria: Could we publish with a note "performance varies by config" and add certified badge later? legal might be picky.
sara: Let's aim to keep the announcement light on numbers, focus on integration + sample apps. follow-up press/data drop once certs are in.
jon: Action items: (1) kevin => gateway auth PR and sample app (due 3/28), (2) maria => confirm embedding dims with LlamaIndex + perf note wording (due 3/25), (3) clara => marketplace draft + assets (due 4/1), (4) sara => coordinate joint announcement PR and spokespersons (due 4/8).
kevin: putting a draft branch: `integration/langchain-sample` and I'll add a README and demo script.
clara: Heads up — marketplace requires a 1MB max logo and a short 60 char summary.
maria: i'll mock the schema mapping doc and paste it here later.
jon: partner ask — LangChain wants to co-host a webinar the week after announcement. we should confirm speakers and demo ownership.
sara: ok schedule tentative: webinar 4/22. jon, can you confirm with LangChain?
jon: on it, pinging @langchain-evangelist (outside thread).
kevin: small TODO for infra: add a feature flag so we can toggle gateway passthrough during canary. cc @deploy-bot for rollout notes.
deploy-bot: noted — feature flag `langchain_gateway_passthrough` created in staging. use `--flag=langchain_gateway_passthrough` for local run.
clara: final note — if we end up delaying perf certs, we still want marketplace presence. recommend leaving a placeholder metrics section that we can update post-cert.
sara: agreed. thanks team — i'll consolidate these action items into a short playbook and post an updated timeline tomorrow. :thumbsup:
